result:
All six required patches are addressed, and I verified the two schema-dependent claims (patches 3 and 5) directly against `proposal-plan-v0.schema.json`.

- **Patch 1** (creation candidates): Lines 106–116 exempt `target_paths`/`target_path` from graph-existence resolution, remove own targets from the reference set before resolving, keeping only non-target references required. ✓
- **Patch 2** (static binding classification): Lines 150–169 mandate "static, deterministic classification only," explicitly forbid executing target-project commands, and gate any future dynamic check behind per-family expected-failure signatures. ✓
- **Patch 3** (strict skippedFindings + singular reason): Lines 398–400 use `{finding_id, rank, title, reason, evidence_paths}` — an exact match to the schema's `$defs.skippedFinding` (additionalProperties:false, those 5 required) — and collapse `reasons[]` into a singular `reason` string. ✓
- **Patch 4** (deterministic citable tokens): Lines 279–289 define a per-candidate citable-evidence set and a validator that accepts only exact tokens; non-empty enforced (guaranteed by required `target_paths`). ✓
- **Patch 5** (lineage preserved verbatim): Line 401 preserves `snapshotId`, `projectRoot`, `repoFactsHash`, `baseLineage`, `sourceScorecardId` — covers all source-lineage top-level required fields. ✓
- **Patch 6** (truthful cost): Line 153 + cost formula avoid dynamic binding-probe execution. ✓
